subject: Which option to choose:  inla.binary.install on ubuntu 16 and R version 3.6.2

messages.author: e7cc390b005447b3
messages.subject: Which option to choose:  inla.binary.install on ubuntu 16 and R version 3.6.2
parts:
Hello,

One of the servers where I work has Ubuntu 16 and R version 3.6.2. We have newer versions of both Ubuntu and R but not on that server.

I tried inla.binary.install instead of INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()

However, the options appear to be empty:

* Looking for Version_21.02.22-1 
 Available alternatives: 
 Chose alternative [1:0]  

Is Ubuntu 16 not supported anymore? 

From another post: "Is supported. When we transfer to R-4.0, then we will leave Ubuntu 16.04"
(Installing INLA on linux sytem (google.com))

This means I have to install an older version of INLA

Am I right?

Fredrik

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Which option to choose:  inla.binary.install on ubuntu 16 and R version 3.6.2
